# test bolero get -tool
bolero get -tool example.com/tools/cmd/hello@v1.0.0
cmp go.mod go.mod.want

bolero get -u tool
cmp go.mod go.mod.upgraded

# test -tool with @none
bolero get -tool example.com/tools/cmd/hello@none
cmp go.mod go.mod.gone

bolero mod tidy
cmp go.mod go.mod.empty

# test -tool with wildcards
bolero get -tool ./cmd/...
cmp go.mod go.mod.wildcard
! bolero get -tool ./cmd/...@none
stderr 'can''t request explicit version "none" of path "./cmd/..." in main module'

# test -tool with all
! bolero get -tool all
stderr 'bolero get -tool does not work with "all"'

# test tool@none
! bolero get tool@none
stderr 'can''t request explicit version of "tool" pattern'

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}

-- go.mod --
module example.com/foo
go 1.24

-- go.mod.want --
module example.com/foo

go 1.24

tool example.com/tools/cmd/hello

require example.com/tools v1.0.0 // indirect
-- go.mod.upgraded --
module example.com/foo

go 1.24

tool example.com/tools/cmd/hello

require example.com/tools v1.1.0 // indirect
-- go.mod.gone --
module example.com/foo

go 1.24

require example.com/tools v1.1.0 // indirect
-- go.mod.empty --
module example.com/foo

go 1.24
-- go.mod.wildcard --
module example.com/foo

go 1.24

tool (
	example.com/foo/cmd/a
	example.com/foo/cmd/b
)
-- cmd/a/a.go --
package a

func main() {}

-- cmd/b/b.go --
package b

func main() {}
